capabilities: Search files by full pinyin, initials, traditional characters, or shuangpin
Execute commands through a pinyin-searchable palette with pinning
Search and jump to headings in the current note
Move files or folders to a pinyin-searched folder
Autocomplete tags and links via pinyin suggestions
disambiguation: Not a pinyin input method; it only adds pinyin matching to Obsidian's search and selection panels.
extras: README is written in Chinese; the author requests donations (打赏) and notes double pinyin and fuzzy pinyin cannot be enabled together.
intentEvidence: 与核心插件模板功能相同，仅加入拼音搜索功能
problem: Obsidian's built-in search and switchers match typed characters literally, so Chinese notes cannot be found by typing pinyin or its initials.
summary: Pinyin fuzzy-search plugin that adds Chinese pinyin matching to file search, command execution, headings, tags, links, templates, and file moving.
